article.title: PostgreSQL Patches 52 Flaws, Including 22-Year-Old Bug Enabling Authenticated RCE
article.summary: A type confusion flaw in PostgreSQL lets a database user who can create objects run code on the server. Updates released yesterday fix it, along with 51 other security flaws. Full protection from this flaw also requires rebuilding any C-language extensions installed on the server. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-6460, has a CVSS score of 8.8. article.title: Nightmare Eclipse Drops Windows Zero-Day Exploit ‘SignDrop’
article.summary: It abuses CLFS and Windows Defender to trigger arbitrary file creation in the context of the antimalware process. The post Nightmare Eclipse Drops Windows Zero-Day Exploit ‘SignDrop’ appeared first on SecurityWeek .

article.title: New Mior and Skyfall Attacks Let Rogue Cloud Hosts Steal Secrets From AMD SEV-SNP VMs
article.summary: Two attacks made public this week allow a malicious host to read data inside AMD SEV-SNP-protected virtual machines (VMs), which are built to keep the server's operator out. One of them, Mior, can also modify a VM's memory and fake the signed report confirming which software it runs. article.title: FBI flash alert says Artex tool automating cyberattacks at ‘machine speed’
article.summary: Open source hacking tool Artex "significantly reduces the time required to chain attack techniques, with some intrusions progressing from initial targeting to privileged access in under three hours," the FBI said.
